title: 上海高考翻译背诵-44-26嘉定/虹口一模

items.zh: 一个个小型美术馆在上海的社区中悄然兴起了。
items.en: In the neighborhoods of Shanghai, small art galleries are quietly emerging one by one.

items.zh: 每天多喝一瓶食糖饮料，心脏病的风险可能增加三成。
items.en: Drinking one extra sugary drink per day may raise the risk of heart disease by 30%.

items.zh: 每逢刮风下雨，乡间的小路总是泥泞的。
items.en: Whenever it is windy or rainy, country paths are always too muddy to walk on.

items.zh: 越是让人感到愉悦，获得成就感的事情，我们就容易反复去做。
items.en: The mor enjoyable and rewarding something feels, the more likely we are to do it repeatedly.

items.zh: 随着乒乓球友谊赛的圆满落幕，我们再次体会到：无论输赢，每个人都是胜利者。
items.en: As the table tennis friendly match came to a successful close, we realized once again that regardless of victory or defeat, everyone is a winner.
